properties.name: what_next served: marked / ranked / one unexplored. Builds the ranking half of req:what-next (accepted 2026-07-31) whose capability had sat `planned` with an EXPIRED blocker nobody noticed. Three bands because the user's own approver-marking is durable self-prioritisation that no score may reorder, and ranking somebody's own marks back at them says nothing; the fifth slot is a required exploration term, derived independently from the Q-table framing and from Anthony's own "top 4 and bottom 1". Score is deliberately coarse against his stated criterion that a rough top-N beats a flat list of 86. Rotation for the unexplored pick comes from the count of settled decisions — no clock, no RNG, and it advances exactly when a decision is made.
